# NichNeumor

NichNeumor is a skeuomorphic light and dark theme with realistic button presses, floating paper menus, embossed images and printer-style tables. It adds typewriter key effects, centered headers and image float, size and wrap controls in a low-saturation writing space. The recorded description names compatibility with Excalidraw, Better Export PDF and ProZen.

![NichNeumor screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nichtigott/NichNeumor/HEAD/Picture/preview.jpg)

```cue

    name:   "NichNeumor"
    author: "nichtigott"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a skeuomorphic light/dark theme with realistic button presses, floating paper menus, embossed images and printer-style tables. Create a focused, low-saturation writing space with typewriter key effects, centered headers, advanced image float/size/wrap controls, and compatibility with Excalidraw, Better Export PDF and ProZen."
}
```
